minecraft:written_book_content.author: Sgt. R. Coyle
pages: {"text": "Proving ledger. All gear bound for the far stations is tried here first: suits, breathing hoods, the wind-engines.\n\nVault keys issued to passing crews only."}
{"text": "Wind-engine trial: three crew winded, one lost a hand to the rotor. Passed for service.\n\nRequisitions from the Tidewell for sealed hoods. From the Listening Post: wax, for ears."}
{"text": "Requisitions stopped in the spring. No crews come through.\n\nWe keep testing. The engines run whether anyone watches or not."}
{"text": "Orders were to hold until relieved.\n\nNobody has come to relieve us. If you are reading this, you are the relief. The keys are in the vaults. Take them."}
